$note: Keys the two old catalogues both defined, with different text. One wording is chosen here on purpose, because 'whichever catalogue the resolver happened to reach first' is what produced the divergence. Register is second person informal throughout — the majority of the tree already used it, and es-419 B2B products (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365) use it too; 'Por favor' is dropped because it padded every sentence without adding anything.

errors.auth_invalid_credentials.note: Must read identically to errors.auth_user_not_found. A message that distinguishes 'no such account' from 'wrong password' confirms to an attacker which addresses are registered (CWE-204).

errors.auth_user_not_found.note: Deliberately identical to errors.auth_invalid_credentials — see that key.

errors.auth_user_inactive.en: Your account is inactive. Contact your organization's administrator.
errors.auth_user_inactive.pt: A tua conta está inativa. Contacta o administrador da tua organização.

errors.auth_token_invalid.en: That link or code is not valid.
errors.auth_token_invalid.pt: Esse link ou código não é válido.
errors.auth_token_invalid.note: This code covers a verification link or e-mail token, not the session. The client copy said 'your session is no longer valid', which described a different failure.
